snippet.title: Fury of the Earth
snippet.description:
Fury of the Earth is a documentary-style channel dedicated to exploring the most powerful forces shaping our planet. Here, we reveal the complete history behind Earth’s greatest geological events — volcanoes, earthquakes, tectonic plate movements, mega-eruptions, climate-changing disasters, and the natural phenomena that transformed human civilization.

Our mission is to turn complex Earth science into clear, visual, and captivating storytelling. Each video brings you full-history explanations, scientific accuracy, and immersive cinematic narratives about iconic events such as Pompeii, Tambora, Krakatoa, Mount St. Helens, Yellowstone, and many more.

This channel is perfect for audiences who love:
🌋 Volcanoes & volcanology
🌎 Geology & tectonic plates
📜 Historical mega-eruptions
🌪️ Extreme natural disasters
🔬 Earth science explained clearly
🎥 Full documentary-style storytelling

Here, we don’t just report the event — we uncover the complete history behind it.

snippet.title: FORGOTTEN HISTORY
snippet.description:
Welcome to Forgotten History where the stories they don’t want you to remember finally come to light. Hosted by Colin Heaton and Michael Droberg, we expose the hidden truth behind some of the most shocking, forgotten, or intentionally buried events in history. From government coverups and military conspiracies to bizarre true stories that defy the textbooks, we dig deep to reveal what really happened. With new episodes every week, our mission is simple: tell the truth, spark critical thinking, and challenge the sanitized version of history you've been fed. Subscribe if you're ready to uncover the past they hoped you'd forget.
Topics we cover:
Political Corruption
Government secrets and scandals
Military operations and false flags
Suppressed inventions and media manipulation
Real stories of resistance, betrayal, and forgotten heroes
🎥 This is not your classroom history—this is the real story.

snippet.title: Snoozy Science
snippet.description:
Welcome to Snoozy Science.

This is where science slows down.

In a world that moves too fast, these stories take their time.
We explore the deepest parts of the ocean, the earliest moments of Earth, the quiet mechanics of space, and the strange events that shaped life as we know it… all told in a calm, steady voice designed to help your mind unwind.

Every episode is built on real science. No fiction. No exaggeration.
Just carefully researched ideas, explained in a way that feels easy to follow, even at the end of a long day.

Some people come here to learn.
Some come to relax.
Most stay for both.

Whether you’re lying in bed, winding down after a long day, or simply curious about the world, you’re in the right place.

New long-form documentaries released regularly.

If you enjoy calm, immersive science storytelling, consider subscribing.

And if you’re listening right now… you’re not alone.

snippet.title: OzGeology
snippet.description: The core mission of OzGeology is to make geology exciting, accessible, and inspiring for everyone. Instead of presenting rocks and earth science as dry or overly academic, OzGeology brings stories of the planet to life, revealing how every mountain, mineral, and landscape tells part of Earth’s grand adventure. The goal is to help people see the world differently, to understand the dynamic forces shaping Australia and beyond, and to spark curiosity in the next generation of geologists. Through engaging storytelling, field exploration, and clear explanations, OzGeology turns the study of our planet into a journey of discovery rather than a classroom lecture.

snippet.title: Vanished Worlds
snippet.description:
Some worlds end in fire. Some drown beneath the waves. Some simply vanish — leaving ruins we still can't explain.

VANISHED WORLDS is a cinematic journey into the lost chapters of human history: drowned cities, forgotten civilizations, ancient technologies that shouldn't exist, and catastrophes that erased entire ages from memory.

Every episode is built like a documentary — cold facts, real discoveries, verified dates and findings — and shaped like a mystery. We follow the evidence into the places official history prefers to leave in the dark.

From the deep past to the edge of the unknown: pre-flood civilizations, sunken lands, impossible artifacts, vanished peoples, and the questions science still can't close.

New episodes regularly. The past is deeper than you were told.

snippet.title: VolcanoDiscovery
snippet.description:
Volcanic activity world-wide shown through videos taken during our volcano tours and expeditions complimented by some time-lapse videos from webcams. 
This channel supplements the volcano news section on https://www.volcanodiscovery.com/ where you can find more about us. 
Volcano-webcams live: http://webcams.volcanodiscovery.com

VolcanoDiscovery is the result of a team effort with several individual video and photo contributors, including:
- volcanologist Dr. Tom Pfeiffer
- expedition organizers Andi Rosadi and Galih Jati from our Indonesian team,
- volcano photographer Martin Rietze (http://www.mrietze.com/),
- volcano hunter Ronny Quireyns and Patrick Barois
- geologist Dr Ingrid Smet
- Etna specialist Emanuela Carone and Roland Broers
- photographer Tobias Schorr
and several others.

Want to contribute? If you like to contribute and become a member of the VolcanoDiscovery Video group, please get in touch with us through email to info (at) volcanodiscovery (dot) com.

snippet.title: Geoclysm
snippet.description:
GEOCLYSM is an independent documentary channel about historical disasters, geological events, and engineering failures.

We tell each story through documented evidence: maps, reports, archival records, survivor accounts, and the physical mechanics of the event. Each episode traces the geography, decisions, failures, and forces that shaped the disaster.

When footage is missing, destroyed, or does not show the mechanism clearly, we use directed and edited visual reconstructions. These scenes are illustrative and are never presented as authentic archival footage.

Production Team:
Anna — historical and archival research, source review, and script support
Vlady — mapping, sound design, video editing, and final assembly

snippet.title: Critical Event
snippet.description:
History doesn’t collapse quietly.

Critical Event explores the moments when everything changes — the eruptions, disasters, and turning points that reshaped entire civilizations. 🌍

From volcanic explosions and maritime tragedies to structural failures and decisive historical events, each episode reconstructs real-world catastrophes with cinematic storytelling and careful research.

We focus on the chain reactions, the human decisions, and the fragile systems that led to irreversible outcomes.

This channel is about understanding how critical moments unfold — step by step — and why they matter.

Some visual and audio elements are enhanced with the support of artificial intelligence tools to help bring these stories to life.

If you’re drawn to the moments when history breaks — subscribe to Critical Event.

New videos every Friday.

Witness the turning points. Understand the collapse.

snippet.title: The Infographic Captain
snippet.description:
The Infographic Captain's official YouTube account.
To educate, inspire and entertain—one fun fact video at a time.

We enjoy sharing entertaining and engaging educational videos. We provide information on unique and fascinating topics. We want to simplify complex ideas using infographic animations.

The infographic captain hopes to motivate you to learn, create, and educate you by using historical events like the first explosion, the first man to walk on the moon, and the first step on Mars.
